title: Add a --json flag to the stats CLI
text:
bin/cli.js prints a five-line text summary of the numbers given on the
command line. Add a --json flag:

  node bin/cli.js --json 1 2 3

must print exactly one line, JSON.stringify(summary), where summary is
the object returned by summarize() in src/stats.js, and nothing else.
Without --json the current text output must stay byte for byte the same.
Document the flag in README.md under Usage.
